capabilities: Render Mathematica notebooks with formatted formulas
Show a read-only original source view
Expand cell source and toggle math previews
Auto-refresh when the file changes externally
extras: Desktop only; the declared minimum Obsidian 1.5.0 is untested on a real install and full native desktop acceptance is outstanding. Only text-form notebooks under 12 MiB are read; graphics, dynamic content, and oversized formulas fall back to source, and saved Output cells cannot be recomputed. Detailed limits and troubleshooting are in Chinese sections and TESTING.md.
problem: Obsidian cannot open Mathematica .nb notebooks, leaving their formulas and content unreadable inside the vault.
summary: Read-only viewer that renders Mathematica .nb notebooks with formatted formulas and a source view inside Obsidian.
